profile.headline: Sr Software Engineer at Baylor Genetics
profile.summary:
I’m a Microsoft‑certified technology leader with 20 years of experience architecting and delivering large‑scale, cloud‑native systems, microservices, and enterprise platforms. My work centers on building resilient, high‑performance solutions using C#, .NET Core, modern API ecosystems, and distributed architectures on AWS and Azure DevOps.
 
I specialize in end‑to‑end solution design, API and integration architecture, and leading complex SDLC initiatives across insurance, energy, e‑commerce, and government domains. I bring deep expertise in cloud engineering—designing event‑driven, serverless, and high‑availability systems using AWS services such as S3, EventBridge, Lambda, DynamoDB, CloudWatch, and API Gateway.
 
I’m also an early adopter of AI‑accelerated engineering, using advanced Copilot prompting and Replit‑based rapid prototyping to speed up architecture, code generation, testing, and documentation while maintaining strong domain logic, security, and engineering rigor.

positions.title: Sr Software Engineer
positions.description: I recently joined Baylor Genetics as a Senior Software Engineer. I am excited to learn the genetics space and apply my engineering skills to build reliable software. My goal is to collaborate with the team and create tools that directly support patient care and scientific discovery.

positions.title: Sr. Software Developer
positions.description:
•	Developed scalable microservices using C# and .NET Core. Integrated APIs with RestSharp and managed a hybrid data architecture involving PostgreSQL, SQL Server, and AWS DynamoDB. Deployed all services on AWS cloud (ECS) infrastructure.
•	Applied GitHub Copilot and M365 Copilot prompting techniques to enhance development workflows.
•	Architected and Digitize solution for Coaction's Partners, Customers and Underwriters.
•	Maintained and enhanced core APIs for Binding Authority and Managing General Agent (MGA) platforms for over two years, focusing on system reliability, performance, and regulatory compliance.
•	Configured and managed document workflows in ImageRight desktop application.
•	Utilized Fluent Validation for validation logic, Moq for unit testing, and Swagger and Postman for API development and testing.
•	Implemented application logging using AutoLogger and conducted monitoring via Splunk and AWS CloudWatch Logs for comprehensive production support.
•	Developed CLI application integrating Coverity and Black Duck APIs to automate security scans across all microservices.
•	Created an automated command-line utility using Selenium, JSON Compare library, and RegEx to cross-reference UI data with backend API payloads, ensuring data synchronization and generating detailed reports.
•	Designed system architecture diagrams in Miro to facilitate team alignment and review sessions.
•	Applied Agile methodologies to the development process, including executing two-week sprints, participating in retrospectives, and conducting sprint demos.
•	Collaborated closely with Business Analysts during requirements gathering and sprint planning, and with QA specialists to validate functional specifications and streamline the testing cycle.
•	Managed end-to-end production deployments via CI/CD pipelines, including creating Change Requests (CRs), generating Release Notes, performing pre- and post-deployment validation, code tagging, and code merging.

positions.description:
Environment: 
C#.Net 4.5, ASP.Net 4.5, MVC, Python, CSHTML, HTML, XML, XSLT, CSS ,IIS, java script, JQuery, AngularJS, Bootstrap, ASP.NET Web API, User Control,  Soap UI, Fiddler, TFS

Preference Center (PC) II (My Account) - Preference Center is customer facing website which is design  to provide communication management tool within Center Point Energy website. (https://myaccount.centerpointenergy.com). The upgrades now let customers to enter their enrollment profile, list and update their contact information (phone, landline, emails) and sign up for Payment Alert emails and texts, able to select and setup their own preferences, such as: Bill delivery method (paper or paperless/electronic), Payment reminder (formerly referred to as Bill Reminder Notification), Past due alert, Payment Confirmation, Power Outage Notifications etc. It also allows to linking between Gas and Electric accounts.

CSR Tool – It’s a web based application used by Customer Service representative to provide support for Center point energy customers (who enroll for preference center). Enhance existing application in such a way that it can share same pages and code as PC and make easy code maintenance. It also provides same or more features like PC to smooth customer as well as operator’s duty. 

Responsibilities: 

•	Design  and enhance applications using ASP.NET MVC and C#.Net
•	Implement style sheet using CSS, HTML, and Bootstrap for desktop mobile and tablet.
•	Implement PAS – Power Alert System, which allow to set up Electric Outage Notifications.
•	Implement Client side validation using Java scripts, Regular expressions, Jquery.
•	Use Web Api, REST service, JSON, soap UI etc.
•	Experience in Unit testing, Module testing and Integration Testing
•	Responsible for fixing and troubleshooting the bugs.  
•	Use TFS for version control and TFS build
•	Implement solution with Agile with weekly scrum followed by demo session.
